blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models support personalized tutoring, content generation, and adaptive learning paths. However, capability development requires these resources and interactions to form a coherent learning process that evolves with the learner. A central challenge is to align goals, activities, and assessment while using learning evidence to decide what should follow. We introduce Human-Participatory Multi-Agent Organization and instantiate it in Agentic University (AU). In AU, learners participate as organization members and work with specialized agents to maintain a revisable Capability Program. The program connects personal goals, learning activities across modalities, and layered assessment, while learner feedback and performance guide subsequent support. Our evaluation shows advantages in program organization, assessment design, and revision quality. Users achieved larger mean assessment gains (12.19 versus 5.61 points on a 50-point scale) and reported stronger cognitive support. This work contributes an organizational approach to adaptive learning that makes learner participation a continuing basis for multi-agent coordination. The Agentic University project is available at \href{https://github.com/AgenticOrgLab/AgenticUniversity.git}.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型支持个性化的辅导,内容生成,以及适应性的学习路径. 然而,能力发展需要这些资源和互动,以形成一个与学习者一起演变的协调一致的学习进程。 一项中心挑战是在利用学习证据决定应该遵循什么目标的同时,调整目标、活动和评估。 我们介绍人类参与的多代理组织,并在代理大学(AU)进行即时分析。 在非盟,学习者作为组织成员参与,并与专门机构合作,维持一个可修改的能力方案。 该方案将个人目标、跨模式的学习活动以及分层评估联系起来,而学习者的反馈和业绩则指导随后的支助。 我们的评价显示了方案组织、评估设计和修订质量方面的优势。 用户取得了更大的平均评估收益(50分比分比分12.19分比分5.61分)并报告了更强的认知支持. 这项工作有助于对适应性学习采取组织办法,使学习者参与成为多机构协调的持续基础。 代理大学项目可在\href{https://github.com/AgenticOrgLab/Agentic University.git}查询。

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Advances in large language models (LLMs) enable educational systems to
provide personalized tutoring, generate instructional materials, and plan
learning activities [ 37 , 38 , 65 ] .
Recent applications support instructional design [ 73 ] ,
teaching video generation [ 67 ] , and real-time guidance
for human tutors [ 64 ] .
Other systems use learner profiles and feedback to plan and refine
learning paths [ 65 , 71 ] , and use interaction
history to support ongoing tutoring and practice [ 74 ] .

However, for learners seeking to develop their capabilities, generating
instructional materials or conducting tutoring dialogues provides only
part of the required support.
These materials and interactions need to form a coherent learning process
that aligns goals, learning activities, and assessment [ 9 ] .
A system therefore needs to coordinate how different learning artifacts
support an individual learner.
As learning evidence accumulates, it needs to adjust the content of
subsequent activities and how they connect.
A learning path organizes tasks, and instructional content and practice
support those tasks.
Evidence-centered assessment connects claims about learner capability to
observable evidence and the tasks that elicit it [ 48 ] .
Recent work applies this approach to evidence from human-AI writing
interactions [ 21 ] .
Assistance conditions also matter.
A study of high-school mathematics found that better performance during
AI-assisted practice did not necessarily translate into better unaided
performance [ 8 ] .
Difficulties identified during learning should guide subsequent support,
and assessed performance should inform revisions to the learning
path [ 10 ] .
We therefore examine how to organize sustained learning around each
learner’s goals, prior knowledge, and progress.

blocks.en:
We build on role specialization and collaboration in LLM-based multi-agent
systems (MAS) [ 18 , 65 ] to introduce Human-Participatory Multi-Agent Organization.
The framework draws on artifacts as a means of coordinating cooperative
work [ 59 ] .
Its emphasis on learner participation is informed by research on learner
decision making [ 62 ] and human-AI interaction guidelines
on feedback and control [ 3 ] .
We use this framework to develop the Agentic University (AU) system.
AU is designed for learners pursuing specific capability goals, with a
focus on university students.
As Figure 1 shows, each learner participates as
an organization member and jointly maintains a revisable Capability Program with agents.
The program connects personal goals, diverse learning activities across
modalities, and assessment requirements.
The organization provides learning support through a learning path, an
interactive classroom, and layered assessment, and adapts subsequent
learning activities.

We evaluated AU through three studies of program formation,
evidence-guided revision, and human use.
Model-based evaluation identified program organization and assessment

AU users also reported stronger cognitive support.

quality, revision quality, and learner outcomes and experiences.

blocks.en: 2  Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1  From Personalized Tutoring to Coherent Learning Programs
blocks.zh: 2.1 从个性化辅导到协调一致的学习方案

blocks.en:
Personalized learning research connected representations of the learner to instructional decisions.
Knowledge tracing estimated skill acquisition from performance [ 22 ] , and deep knowledge tracing learned representations of learning histories with recurrent neural networks [ 55 ] .
Adaptive hypermedia used learner models to adapt content presentation and navigation [ 14 ] , while AutoTutor used mixed-initiative dialogue to support learning [ 30 ] .
Together, these approaches established personalization at the levels of learner state, content access, and instructional interaction.
blocks.zh:
个性化的学习研究将学习者的陈述与教学决定联系起来。
知识追踪估计从绩效中获得的技能[22],以及深层知识追踪通过反复出现的神经网络对学习历史的所学表现[55]。
适应性超媒体使用学习者模型来适应内容的呈现和导航[14],而AutoTutor则使用混合主动对话来支持学习[30].
这些方法共同建立了学习者状态、内容获取和教学互动层面的个性化。

blocks.en:
Recent systems extended personalization through pedagogically informed generation and course-specific support.
LearnLM incorporated learning-science principles into model development and pedagogical evaluation [ 37 ] , while CourseAssist aligned tutoring responses with course materials and learning objectives through retrieval and question decomposition [ 25 ] .
Other systems broadened the available learning activities through customized instructional design [ 73 ] , teaching-video production [ 67 ] , and agent-supported online classrooms [ 72 ] .
Together, these systems expanded the instructional resources and interactions available for personalized learning.
blocks.zh:
最近的系统通过在教学上知情的生成和针对具体课程的支助,扩大了个性化。
LyarningLM将学习-科学原则纳入模型发展和教学评价[37],而CourseAsist则通过检索和分解问题使辅导反应与课程材料和学习目标相配合[25].
其他系统通过定制教学设计[73]、教学录像制作[67]和代理支助的在线教室[72],扩大了现有的学习活动。
这些系统共同扩大了可用于个性化学习的教学资源和互动。

blocks.en:
A further line coordinated personalization across learning paths.
MALPP coordinated learner analytics, path planning, and reflection agents to iteratively refine personalized paths with explicit rationales [ 71 ] , while Pxplore combined goal-driven learner-state modeling with policy training for personalized path planning [ 43 ] .
GenMentor, our closest system-level comparison, connected goal-to-skill mapping, dynamic learner profiles, instructional content, and quizzes.
It revised learning paths using updated profiles and required learner approval before applying changes [ 65 ] .
DeepTutor shared evolving learner profiles and interaction memory across tutoring functions [ 74 ] .
These systems established precedents for adaptive paths, continuing personalization, and coordinated support.
AU extended this line through a Human-Participatory Multi-Agent Organization for capability development.
The learner participated as an organization member alongside agents responsible for planning, mentoring, assessment, and replanning.
Together, they maintained a revisable Capability Program that connected personal goals, multimodal learning activities, and layered assessment.
The organization used learner contributions and performance evidence to adapt subsequent learning, with the learner retaining control over path changes.
blocks.zh:
另一行是协调跨越学习道路的个人化。
MALPP协调学习者分析,路径规划,和反射剂,以反复完善个性化路径,并有明确的理由[71];而Pxplore则将目标驱动的学习者状态模型化与个性化路径规划的政策培训相结合[43].
GenMentor,我们最接近的系统级比较,连接到的入球与技能映射,动态学习者简介,教学内容,以及问答.
它使用更新的简介修改了学习路径,在应用修改前需要学习者批准[65].
DeepTutor在辅导功能上共享不断发展的学习者简介和互动内存[74].
这些系统为适应性道路、持续的个性化和协调一致的支持创造了先例。
非盟通过一个人-人-人-人-人参与的多代理组织扩大了这一范围,以促进能力发展。
学习者作为组织成员与负责规划、指导、评估和重新规划的代理人一起参加。
它们共同维持了一个可修改的能力方案,将个人目标、多模式学习活动和分层评估联系起来。
该组织利用学习者的贡献和业绩证据来适应后续的学习,学习者保留对路径变化的控制.

blocks.en: 2.2  From Role Specialization to Shared-State Coordination in Multi-Agent Systems
blocks.zh: 2.2 从角色专业化到多代理系统中的国家共享协调

blocks.en:
Research on multi-agent organizations formalized collective activity through agents, groups, and roles [ 26 ] .
MOISE+ further distinguished structural, functional, and deontic specifications, connecting organizational roles to collective goals and obligations [ 35 ] .
LLM-based systems operationalized complementary forms of collaboration.
CAMEL used role-playing to structure agent interaction [ 42 ] , and AgentVerse coordinated teams of agents [ 18 ] .
MetaGPT organized intermediate artifacts through standard operating procedures [ 32 ] , while ChatDev linked specialized roles through a staged software-development process [ 56 ] .
These approaches provided precedents for organizing specialized outputs into collective work.
blocks.zh:
关于多代理人组织的研究通过代理人,团体,角色等形式正式确定集体活动[26].
MOISE+进一步区分了结构、功能和自定义规格,将组织作用与集体目标和义务联系起来[35]。
以LLM为基础的系统实现了互补形式的协作。
CAMEL使用角色扮演来构建代理交互[42],AgentVerse协调的代理团队[18].
MetaGPT通过标准操作程序组织中间出品[32],而ChatDev通过一个有阶段的软件开发过程将专门角色联系起来[56].
这些办法为将专门产出组织到集体工作中提供了先例。

blocks.en:
Later work examined how teams coordinated during execution.
AutoGen supported conversations among agents, tools, and people [ 70 ] .
Internet of Agents supported heterogeneous agents through dynamic teaming [ 19 ] , and Optima trained agents to balance communication efficiency and task effectiveness [ 20 ] .
Magentic-One maintained task and progress ledgers to guide execution and replanning [ 28 ] .
Cemri et al. identified failures involving system design, inter-agent misalignment, and verification in multi-agent execution traces [ 17 ] .
Together, these studies highlighted the importance of coordination rules and shared context alongside role specialization.
blocks.zh:
后来的工作审查了各小组在执行过程中如何协调。
AutoGen支持代理商,工具和人之间的对话[70].
互联网代理公司通过动态团队化[19]和Optima训练有素的代理公司支持各种代理公司,以平衡通信效率和任务效力[20]。
Magentic-One维护任务和进度分类账,以指导执行和再规划[28].
Cemri等查明了涉及系统设计,代理错位,以及多代理执行痕迹的核查等故障[17].
这些研究共同突出了协调规则和共同环境以及角色专业化的重要性。

blocks.en:
Shared artifacts provided a further basis for coordination.
Schmidt and Simone described coordination mechanisms as artifacts coupled with conventions for managing interdependent work [ 59 ] .
Recent work examined the authority and consistency of persistent state: governed collaborative memory distinguished private from institutional memory and connected memory admission to ratification, provenance, and version lineage [ 23 ] ; the Artifact Coherence System serialized writes to each artifact and used versioning and invalidation to coordinate cached copies [ 54 ] .
AU applied an organizational perspective to educational dependencies: its Capability Program connected objectives, prerequisites, activities, assessment requirements, and current program state.
Its evidence records retained sources, conditions, and permitted updates, while its revision history linked evidence and diagnosis to learner-confirmed changes and path versions.
blocks.zh:
共有的文物为协调工作提供了又一基础。
Schmidt和Simone将协调机制描述为与管理相互依存工作的公约相配合的文物[59]。
最近的工作研究了持续状态的权威和一致性:管理合作记忆区分私人记忆和机构记忆,以及连接的记忆录入到批准,出处和版本行进[23];Artifact Concession System序列化地写给每个文物,并使用版本和无效化来协调缓存副本[54].
非盟将组织视角应用于教育依赖性:其能力方案将目标、先决条件、活动、评估要求和当前方案状况联系起来。
其证据记录保留了来源、条件和允许更新,而其修订历史将证据和诊断与学习者确认的变化和路径版本联系起来。

blocks.en: 2.3  Human Participation and Learner Agency
blocks.zh: 2.3 人类参与和学习机构

blocks.en:
Research on learner agency examined how learners influenced AI-supported activity.
Vincoli et al. distinguished agency over content, feedback and help, co-orchestration, and data [ 62 ] .
Dai and Lai identified initiating and redirecting, mindful adoption, external help-seeking, and reflection as interrelated aspects of agency in students’ AI-assisted learning [ 24 ] .
These perspectives situated participation across learning decisions and interactions.
Open learner modeling offered a concrete mechanism by making learner representations inspectable and, in some designs, negotiable or editable [ 16 ] .
blocks.zh:
关于学习机构的研究审查了学习者如何影响AI支持的活动。
Vincoli等人在内容、反馈和帮助、共同组织以及数据方面表现出了突出的作用[62]。
Dai和Lai指出,在学生的AI辅助学习中,发起和调整方向、注意收养、寻求外部帮助和思考是机构相互关联的方面。
这些观点将参与贯穿学习决定和互动。
开放的学习者建模提供了一个具体机制,使学习者的陈述可以检查,在某些设计中,可以谈判或编辑[16]。

blocks.en:
Educational systems also distributed participation across different human roles.
AI2T supported tutor authoring through demonstrations and corrective feedback [ 68 ] , while TeachTune helped teachers inspect pedagogical agents across simulated learner profiles [ 36 ] .
During instruction, Tutor CoPilot supplied suggestions to human tutors [ 64 ] , and the LearnLM classroom trial placed every generated message under expert review before delivery [ 61 ] .
These systems located human judgment in tutor construction, review, and instructional delivery.
blocks.zh:
教育系统还把参与分布在不同的人类角色之间。
AI2T支持辅导员通过演示和矫正反馈撰写[68],而TeachTune帮助教师检查模拟学习者简介的教学人员[36].
在教学期间,导师CoPilot向人类辅导员提供建议[64],学习LM课堂试验将每个生成的信息在交付前置于专家审查之下[61].
这些系统将人的判断定位于辅导员的建造、审查和教学。

blocks.en:
Human–AI interaction research addressed related questions of initiative and control.
Mixed-initiative interaction examined how people and systems shared initiative [ 33 ] , and human–AI interaction guidelines emphasized correction, feedback, and control over time [ 3 ] .
AgentCoord enabled users to inspect and revise multi-agent plans, agent assignments, and task processes [ 53 ] .
In education, LearnMate enabled learners to adjust personalized plans and schedules while receiving contextual support [ 66 ] .
These systems demonstrated concrete ways for people to shape plans and agent behavior.
blocks.zh:
人类-大赦国际互动研究涉及主动和控制的相关问题。
混合倡议性互动研究了人们和系统如何共享举措[33],以及人与AI互动准则如何强调纠正、反馈和控制。
AgentCoord使用户能够检查和修改多代理计划,代理任务,以及任务流程[53].
在教育方面,LearnMate使学习者能够调整个性化计划和时间表,同时获得背景支持[66].
这些系统展示了人们塑造计划和代理行为的具体方法.

blocks.en:
AU investigated how learner contributions remained consequential when educational work passed between roles.
Its Human Node retained goals, constraints, and corrections, while its Capability Program connected those contributions to subsequent planning, mentoring, assessment, and replanning.
Learner confirmation governed the application of path changes.
This design treated continuing participation as part of organizational coordination.
blocks.zh:
非盟调查了当教育工作在角色之间交接时,学习者的贡献如何产生结果。
其人类节点保留了目标、限制和矫正,而其能力方案将这些贡献与随后的规划、指导、评估和再规划联系起来。
学习者确认规范路径变化的应用.
这一设计将持续参与视为组织协调的一部分。

blocks.en: 2.4  Connecting Capability Assessment to Program Revision
blocks.zh: 2.4 将能力评估与方案修订联系起来

blocks.en:
Educational research provided principles for connecting goals, instructional activity, and evidence.
Constructive alignment linked intended outcomes, learning activities, and assessment [ 9 ] .
Evidence-centered design connected capability claims to observable evidence and the tasks that elicited it [ 48 ] , while authentic-assessment research situated assessment in meaningful tasks, contexts, and criteria [ 31 ] .
These perspectives informed AU’s alignment of knowledge-point checks, stage micro-projects, and an integrative simulation with objectives at corresponding scopes.

建设性调整将预期成果、学习活动和评估联系起来[9]。
以证据为中心的设计与能力相关,声称可观察到的证据及其产生这些证据的任务[48],而真正的评估研究则将评估置于有意义的任务、背景和标准[31]。
这些观点为非盟协调知识点检查、阶段微型项目和与相应范围目标的综合模拟提供了依据。

blocks.en:
AI assistance made the interpretation of performance especially consequential.
Cheng et al. used evidence-centered assessment to examine human–AI writing processes [ 21 ] .
Bastani et al. found that better performance during AI-assisted mathematics practice did not necessarily imply better performance after assistance was removed [ 8 ] .
Formative-assessment research connected evidence to subsequent teaching and learning decisions [ 10 , 11 ] .
Sadler further emphasized learners’ understanding of quality, comparison of their work against that standard, and action to close the gap [ 58 ] .
These perspectives motivated AU’s attention to what an observation supported and how it informed subsequent instruction.
AU distinguished Learning-State Evidence for interpreting support needs from Capability Evidence for updating estimates within the assessed task and assistance conditions.
Both informed targeted program revisions, with explicit links to the affected objectives, activities, and assessment requirements.

Bastani等发现,AI辅助数学练习期间表现较好并不一定意味着在被移除后表现较好[8].
格式评估研究将证据与随后的教学和学习决定联系起来[10,11].
萨德勒还进一步强调了学习者对质量的理解,将他们的工作与标准相比较,以及缩小差距的行动[58]。
这些观点促使非盟注意一项意见支持什么,以及它如何为随后的指示提供参考。
非盟在根据评估任务和援助条件更新估计数方面,从能力证据中解释支助需要的学习-国家证据方面表现突出。
这两项目标明确的方案修订都与受影响的目标、活动和评估要求有明确的联系。

activities, interpreting performance, and adapting subsequent work.

blocks.en: 3.3  Findings
blocks.zh: 3.3 调查结果

blocks.en: Italic quotations are English translations of Mandarin interview excerpts.
blocks.zh: 斜体引文为普通话采访节选的英文译文.

blocks.en: 3.3.1  F1: Learner context was fragmented and sometimes inaccurate
blocks.zh: 3.3.1 国家 F1:学习者的背景支离破碎,有时不准确

blocks.en:
Participants carried context across courses, AI conversations, and other resources. L1 explained, “In a new conversation, I usually have to explain my background
again, how far I have learned, and what I still do not understand.” L3 reported that tools lacked context from learning elsewhere. E1 noted that scores and submissions did not convey students’ specific difficulties between instructors.
blocks.zh:
学员们通过各种课程、大赦国际的对话和其他资源了解情况。 L1解释道, “在新的谈话中,我通常必须解释我的背景
再说一遍,我学到了多少,我仍然不明白什么。” L3报告说,其他学习工具缺乏背景。 E1指出,分数和提交书没有在教员之间传达学生的具体困难。

blocks.en: L5’s humanities label also led AI-generated routes to discount prior STEM training, while recommendations for L2 assumed continued commitment to a briefly explored direction. These accounts call for context continuity and correction of inaccurate or outdated assumptions.
blocks.zh: L5的人文标志也导致AI生成的路线对STEM之前的训练进行折扣,而L2的建议则假设继续承诺一个短暂探索的方向. 这些账户要求保持环境连续性并纠正不准确或过时的假设。

blocks.en: 3.3.2  F2: Learning routes left gaps in action and completion criteria
blocks.zh: 3.3.2 F2:学习途径在行动和完成标准方面尚有差距

blocks.en:
L2 wanted a concrete daily task within a short planning horizon; L3 found generated routes fragmented and poorly connected to resources. L1 explained, “The route looks clear, but when I execute it, it is difficult
to judge what counts as finished.” L5 reprioritized learning amid competing doctoral responsibilities. L6 planned workplace learning around immediate delivery demands, while L4 valued fixed courses linked to examination or work goals and including practice. These accounts call for linking broad goals to feasible activities and explicit completion criteria, with planning horizons suited to learners’ circumstances.
blocks.zh:
L2希望在短期规划范围内开展具体日常任务;L3发现生成的路线支离破碎,与资源连接不畅. L1解释道, "路线看起来很清晰,但当我执行它,这是困难的
判断什么是已完成的。” L5在相互竞争的博士职责中重新确定学习的优先次序。 L6计划围绕即时交付需求在工作场所学习,而L4则重视与考试或工作目标有关的固定课程,并包括实践。 这些说明要求将广泛的目标同可行的活动和明确的完成标准联系起来,并有适合学生情况的规划范围。

blocks.en: 3.3.3  F3: Capability judgments depended on tasks and available support
blocks.zh: 3.3.3 F3:能力判断取决于任务和可获得的支助

blocks.en: Participants distinguished activity completion from applying knowledge. L1 could follow a model-training video but struggled with missing values, feature selection, and evaluation on an actual dataset. E1 used explanations and open-ended tasks to assess understanding beyond participation, submissions, or running code, revealing further difficulties.
blocks.zh: 与会者区分了活动完成与应用知识。 L1可以跟随一个模型训练视频,但与缺失的值,特征选择,以及实际数据集的评价相拼. E1使用解释和开放式任务来评估参与、提交或运行代码以外的理解,从而揭示出更多的困难。

blocks.en:
Available assistance also shaped performance judgments. L3 explained, “If I follow the quick start, the project will usually run,
and AI helps me repair pipeline problems. So the project running
by itself does not say much.” L6 described a different workplace criterion: “If you can bring the resources together and complete the
work as the owner, that is also a form of workplace capability.” These accounts distinguish independent technical execution from responsibility for completing work with available resources. Performance evidence therefore needs to be interpreted in relation to the task and support used. L5 also described possible causes of non-completion: knowledge gaps, limited time, competing priorities, and unsuitable resources.
blocks.zh:
现有的援助也影响了业绩判断。 L3解释道, “如果我遵循快速的起步,项目通常会运行,
AI帮助我修复管道问题。 所以项目运行
它本身没有说太多。” L6描述了不同的工作场所标准: “如果你能够汇集资源,完成

blocks.en: 3.3.4  F4: Interpreting difficulties guided subsequent learning choices
blocks.zh: 3.3.4 F4:解释困难,指导以后的学习选择

blocks.en:
L2 described how difficulties guided subsequent learning: “I treat it as a new judgment about the boundary of my capability,
and then decide whether to strengthen it or adjust what I learn next.” L3 gave AI questions and self-produced answers to identify weaknesses and generate follow-up questions. L4 changed explanations or resources when a course did not resolve a difficulty.

然后决定是加强还是调整我接下来学到的东西。” L3给出了AI问题和自发的答案来找出弱点并产生后续问题. L4在课程无法解决困难时改变了解释或资源.

blocks.en: E1 distinguished conceptual misunderstanding from insufficient practice when selecting support and used conversation to interpret conflicting assessment results. These interpretations guided further explanation, practice, resource changes, or revised priorities.

blocks.en: 3.4  Design Goals
blocks.zh: 3.4 设计目标

blocks.en: The four themes and related work informed AU’s design goals and corresponding system support.
blocks.zh: 这四个主题和相关工作为非盟的设计目标和相应的系统支助提供了依据。

blocks.en: AU should retain relevant learner context across interactions and roles, record its sources, and allow learners to correct inaccurate or outdated assumptions. This goal informed the Human Node and selective SharedMemory.
blocks.zh: 非盟应保留相关学习者在互动和角色方面的背景,记录其来源,并允许学习者纠正不准确或过时的假设。 这个目标为人类节点和选择性的共享记忆提供了信息.

blocks.en: AU should connect goals to activities, resources, prerequisites, and explicit completion criteria, consistent with constructive alignment among intended learning outcomes, learning activities, and assessment [ 9 ] . It should track completed, remaining, and deferred work within a program scope suited to the learner’s planning horizon. This goal informed the Capability Program.
blocks.zh: 非盟应将目标与活动、资源、先决条件和明确的完成标准联系起来,与预期学习成果、学习活动和评估之间的建设性协调相一致[9]。 它应该在适合学习者规划范围的方案范围内跟踪已完成、剩余和推迟的工作。 这一目标贯穿于能力方案。

blocks.en: AU should interpret performance in relation to the target capability, task, conditions, timing, and allowed support. This goal informed its assessment design and the distinction between Learning-State Evidence and Capability Evidence.
blocks.zh: 非盟应结合目标能力、任务、条件、时间安排和允许的支持来解释业绩。 这一目标为评估设计和学习-国家证据和能力证据之间的区别提供了依据。

blocks.en: AU should use new evidence and learner input to revise subsequent work, following formative assessment’s use of learning evidence to guide the next instructional step [ 11 ] . Revisions should address identified difficulties, preserve relevant work, and allow learner inspection. AU should support learner review when evidence conflicts or time and other constraints may explain performance.

blocks.en: 4  Agentic University

blocks.en:
Agentic University (AU) supports learners from goal setting through
learning and program revision.
A learner arrives with a goal and begins in a guided conversation,
describing background, preferences, and constraints, and correcting the
system’s assumptions along the way. AU organizes a learning program of
stages and knowledge-point nodes. Within each node, the learner studies
materials, watches instructional videos, and answers Pause-QA questions,
turning to mentors for explanations, examples, or hints as difficulties
arise. Node assessments, stage micro-projects, and a final enterprise
simulation follow, each returning feedback the learner can act on. When assessment results or learning interactions indicate a need for
additional support, AU considers a revision to the remaining path.
It applies proposed changes after learner confirmation.

Learning difficulties often arise while learners are studying a knowledge

The classroom brings together AU-generated instructional videos [ 67 ] , lecture

solution from mentors [ 1 ] . AU selects a mentor by matching
the request against role scope and conversation context. The selected
mentor then responds in light of the node objective and relevant learner
state [ 30 ] . These interactions connect explanation,
reflection, and feedback within each lesson, while the resulting questions,
retries, and confidence reports help AU interpret learning difficulties
and support needs.

blocks.en:
Understanding a knowledge point is one demand; using knowledge across tasks
is another. AU separates these demands into three assessment levels that
examine understanding, application, and integration in turn: • A chapter assessment follows each knowledge-point node.
It checks the learner’s understanding of that point and records grading
details for each answer. • A micro-project follows each stage. It asks the learner to
apply knowledge from several nodes in a task with defined outputs and
assessment criteria [ 12 , 7 ] . • An enterprise simulation follows the learning stages for
the overall goal. It asks the learner to combine knowledge across stages
in a simulated workplace task [ 31 , 6 ] . Every assessment specifies the task, the assessed dimensions, the allowed
support, and the grading criteria [ 48 ] . Where code tasks
support testing, project reviews can combine model feedback with execution
results. Together, the three levels trace a path from local understanding
to broader use of knowledge, and their results feed back at matching scopes:
practice on a knowledge point, review within a stage, or further work on
combining skills.

blocks.en:
The diagnostic panel comprises three separately prompted LLM evaluators.
An evidence auditor checks the evidential support for judgments, a process
observer examines learning behavior and help-seeking, and an outcome
examiner assesses task performance and errors. Each evaluator assesses
all three dimensions, providing complementary perspectives on the same
evidence under a shared rubric. Disagreement beyond a preset tolerance
in any dimension triggers bounded peer review, during which the
evaluators examine one another’s reasoning and reconsider their estimates.
The Replanner aggregates their final estimates using weights obtained
by normalizing each evaluator’s self-reported confidence across the panel.
The resulting diagnosis links gaps between estimated performance and
target requirements to the affected node and the learning requirements
that need support.

blocks.en: 5.3.1  Study Design and Measures
blocks.zh: 5.3.1 研究设计和措施

blocks.en: We analyzed 32 source cases from Study 1 associated with the target role of “AI Agent Development Engineer.” Each case was evaluated at two points along the learning trajectory (early vs. late). For each trajectory position, we specified two target assessment scores (20/100 and 50/100), yielding a fully crossed design with 32 × 2 × 2 = 128 32\times 2\times 2=128 matched case pairs for AU and GenMentor. The two trajectory positions operationalized differing amounts of remaining learning, whereas the two target scores represented distinct levels of low assessment performance. This design allowed us to examine whether revision behavior remained appropriate under both severe and moderate learning difficulties. Each system maintained its own initial programs and assessment items. Case matching controlled for learner profile, trajectory position, and target score. All experiments employed the model configuration described in Study 1.

We used four measures to assess program improvement, path coherence,
revision decisions, and their supporting evidence. Program Improvement measures the change in program quality
relative to the system’s own initial program. It assesses whether
the revised program better fits the learner’s current state. Post-Revision Path Coherence measures whether the revised
path maintains prerequisite relationships, coherent stage transitions,
and appropriate difficulty progression. We use this measure to
check whether the added support fits the remaining program. Revision Decision Appropriateness measures whether the
chosen changes address the learner’s needs and preserve content

blocks.en: 6  Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: AU offers a concrete way to organize educational work around a person whose capabilities, goals, and constraints can change through participation. The broader significance of this approach lies in sustaining human influence across agent roles and keeping the learning program aligned with the learner’s current state and goals. We develop these implications from the system design and the complementary findings of our three studies.
blocks.zh: 非盟为围绕一个人组织教育工作提供了具体途径,他的能力、目标和制约因素可以通过参与来改变。 这种方法的更广泛意义在于维持人对代理角色的影响,使学习方案与学习者的现状和目标保持一致。 我们从系统设计和我们三项研究的补充结论中发展出这些影响。

blocks.en: 6.1  Human Participation as a Continuing Basis for Coordination
blocks.zh: 6.1 人类参与作为持续协调的基础

blocks.en: Participation in a multi-agent organization requires that what a person contributes remain connected to what different roles subsequently do. The formative interviews exposed the effort of repeatedly reconstructing learner context across tools and interactions. AU responds with two connected representations: the Human Node maintains the current account of the learner, and the Capability Program records the work organized around that account, so that a contribution made in one interaction remains relevant to later planning, mentoring, and assessment decisions.
blocks.zh: 参与一个多代理人组织需要一个人的贡献与随后的不同作用保持联系。 形成性访谈揭示了在工具和互动之间反复重建学习者背景的努力。 非盟通过两个相互联系的表述作出回应:人类节点保持学习者的经常账户,能力方案记录围绕该账户组织的工作,以便在一个互动中作出的贡献仍然与以后的规划、指导和评估决定相关。

blocks.en: Existing systems such as GenMentor establish the value of dynamic profiles and evolving paths [ 65 ] . Our organizational perspective adds a criterion: meaningful participation depends on whether contributions remain consequential when work passes between roles. A constraint stated during planning, a difficulty encountered during practice, or a correction to an inferred background can each become a reason to reconsider future work. For HCI, AU offers a concrete design pattern for giving human input revisable effects that persist across roles within coordinated activity.
blocks.zh: GenMentor等现有系统确定了动态剖面图和不断发展路径的价值 [65]. 我们的组织观点增加了一个标准:有意义的参与取决于工作在角色之间交接时是否仍然产生影响。 规划期间所述的限制、实践过程中遇到的困难或对所推断背景的纠正,都可以成为重新考虑今后工作的理由。 非洲联盟为国际家庭护理组织提供了一个具体的设计模式,以赋予人类投入可预见影响,这种影响在协调活动内的各种作用中持续存在。

blocks.en: 6.2  Maintaining Learning Continuity as Learners Change
blocks.zh: 6.2 随着学习者的改变,保持学习连续性

blocks.en: Learning changes the conditions under which its own plan was formed: developing knowledge can reveal unrecognized prerequisites, and experience may alter what a learner considers useful or feasible. A program therefore needs to track the learner’s current state while preserving the value of completed work—a tension the Capability Program makes explicit by linking goals, activities, assessment requirements, and revisions within a continuing trajectory.
blocks.zh: 学习会改变制定自己的计划的条件:发展知识可以揭示未确认的先决条件,经验可以改变学习者认为有用或可行的条件。 因此,一个方案需要跟踪学习者的现状,同时保留已完成工作的价值——能力方案通过在持续轨迹中将目标、活动、评估要求和修订联系起来来明确表明这种紧张关系。

blocks.en: The studies support both halves of this commitment. Study 1’s clearest advantages appeared precisely in program organization and assessment design. Study 2 adds evidence about maintaining these relationships through change: AU received higher ratings for revision appropriateness, improvement, and coherence even though both systems received high evidence-alignment ratings, suggesting that useful adaptation depends on how a response to difficulty fits into subsequent learning rather than on reading evidence alone. This perspective makes the program’s continuing suitability itself an object of evaluation: an unsuccessful attempt can prompt examination of prerequisite assumptions, activity demands, or available support alongside the learner’s understanding, and revision can then preserve achievements while updating the conditions for further progress. The present studies demonstrate bounded program revision; sustained trajectories remain a direction for validation.
blocks.zh: 这两项研究都支持这项承诺的一半。 研究1最明显的优势恰恰出现在方案安排和评估设计中。 研究2补充了通过变革维持这些关系的证据:非盟在修订适当性、改进性和一致性方面获得了更高的评级,尽管这两个系统都获得了较高的证据调整评级,这表明有用的调整取决于对困难的反应如何与随后的学习相适应,而不是仅靠阅读证据。 这种观点使得方案本身的持续适用性成为评价的对象:不成功的尝试可以促使对先决条件假设、活动要求或与学习者的理解相关的现有支持进行审查,修订可以保留成就,同时更新取得进一步进展的条件。 目前的研究表明,有限度的程序修订;持续的轨迹仍然是验证的方向。

blocks.en: 6.3  Making Adaptive Organizations Accountable to Learners
blocks.zh: 6.3 建立适应性组织 对学习者负责

blocks.en: An organization that maintains an account of the learner also influences how progress is interpreted and which opportunities follow. Study 3 associated AU use with stronger cognitive support and larger objective assessment gains, while differences in self-efficacy and Metacognition gains were not statistically significant; interview accounts of fatigue and reconsidered understanding illustrate why performance and judgments of progress may diverge. Learners should therefore be able to see what particular evidence supports and how it informs subsequent work.
blocks.zh: 一个对学习者进行叙述的组织也影响如何解释进展,以及随之而来的机会。 研究3将非盟的使用与更强的认知支持和更大的客观评估收益联系起来,而自我效能和元认知收益方面的差异在统计学上并不显著;访谈疲劳的叙述和重新考虑的理解说明了为什么业绩和对进展的判断可能有所不同。 因此,学习者应当能够看到具体证据支持什么,以及它如何为以后的工作提供信息。

blocks.en: Correction and control [ 3 ] must accordingly hold across the whole organization, not only at the interface where a learner happens to be working—as when a background label overlooked a learner’s prior training and shaped future opportunities. Corrections should affect the shared state used by subsequent roles, capability judgments should remain bounded by task and assistance conditions, and goals should stay open to reconsideration as priorities change. Shared representations make these relationships explicit enough to inspect and revise, and could support human educators and specialist agents working around a learner-owned program; our system-level results motivate this direction without isolating the effects of individual agents or establishing a general theory of human-participatory organization.
blocks.zh: 因此,校正和控制[3]必须贯穿整个组织,不仅仅是在学习者恰好在工作的界面上,就像背景标签忽略了学习者以前的培训和塑造未来的机会一样。 纠正措施应影响后续角色使用的共同状态,能力判断应始终受任务和援助条件的约束,随着优先事项的改变,目标应随时考虑。 共同的表述使得这些关系足够明确,可以检查和修改,并且可以支持在学习者拥有的方案周围工作的人类教育工作者和专家代理人;我们系统一级的成果激励着这一方向,而不孤立个别代理人的影响,也不建立人类参与组织的一般理论。

blocks.en: 6.4  From Personal Programs to Organizational Learning
blocks.zh: 6.4 从个人方案到组织学习

blocks.en: Although our studies evaluate only single-learner programs, the representations AU uses—Human Nodes, Capability Programs, and evidence records—also create conditions for learning across learners. A Capability Program records not only what activities a learner completed but also which revisions were triggered, what evidence supported them, and whether those revisions led to subsequent success. Aggregated across learners pursuing related goals, these records could inform the planning role’s initial path construction, where recurring prerequisite gaps suggest reordering, and the mentoring role’s choice of explanations, where recurring misconceptions suggest addressing a difficulty before it arises. This organizational learning depends on the evidence discipline described above: capability claims must remain bounded by their conditions and learner corrections must remain legible, so that the organization improves through accountable use of participant evidence rather than opaque pattern-matching that reinforces earlier biases.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们的研究只评价单发学生方案,但非盟的表述方式——人文节点、能力方案和证据记录——也为学习者之间的学习创造了条件。 一个能力方案不仅记录了学习者完成的活动,而且还记录了引发了哪些修订,哪些证据支持这些活动,以及这些修订是否导致随后的成功。 在追求相关目标的学习者中,这些记录可以为规划角色的起步路径构建提供信息,其中反复出现的先决条件差距意味着重新排序,而指导角色选择解释,其中反复出现的误解表明在出现困难之前要解决一个问题。 这种组织学习取决于上述证据学科:能力主张必须始终受条件限制,学习者的纠正必须始终清晰可辨,以便本组织通过负责任地使用参与者证据来改进,而不是通过不透明的模式匹配来强化先前的偏见。

blocks.en: 7  Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 7 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: Our studies evaluated complete system configurations through selected synthetic cases and a short human study. Studies 1 and 2 used LLM-based evaluation under a fixed model configuration; Study 1 also examined correlations between expert and model ratings on a subset of cases. Evaluator models and scoring prompts may affect automated judgments [ 75 ] , motivating broader human review and comparisons across evaluators. Study 3 involved 32 learners aged 18–30, with recruitment focused on university students. Larger studies across age groups and racial, ethnic, and cultural communities could assess broader generalizability. Since systems differed in instructional formats and practice requirements, component studies and comparisons accounting for actual learning time could clarify the contributions of AU’s organizational mechanisms, content formats, and practice opportunities.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究通过选取的合成病例和简短的人类研究评估了完整的系统配置. 研究1和2在固定模式配置下采用了基于LLM的评价; 研究1还研究了专家与模型评级在一个子集中的相关性. 评价员模型和评分提示可能影响自动判断[75],从而促使对评价员进行更广泛的人文审查和比较。 第3期学习涉及32名18-30岁的学生,其招聘重点是大学生。 跨年龄组、种族、族裔和文化群体进行更广泛的研究,可以评估更广泛的普遍性。 由于各系统在教学格式和做法要求上各不相同,组成部分研究和实际学习时间的比较可以澄清非盟组织机制、内容格式和做法机会的贡献。

blocks.en: AU’s decisions depend on the evidence carried through the Human Node. Errors in generated materials or assessment feedback may affect subsequent teaching and revision. AU records evidence sources and supports learner correction; how effectively these mechanisms resolve errors across roles requires further study. Independent reviews of instructional content and scoring could be combined with studies of concrete correction episodes: a learner challenges a diagnosis, updates a profile, or rejects a proposed change, and the organization responds. Following these episodes across mentoring and planning would show whether learner input has a lasting effect on subsequent work. Such studies could also examine how the organization handles conflicting evidence and when consultation with a human educator is useful.
blocks.zh: 非盟的决定取决于通过人类节点携带的证据。 生成的材料或评估反馈的错误可能影响后续的教学和修订. 非盟记录证据来源并支持学习者的改正;这些机制如何有效解决各种角色的错误,需要进一步研究。 对教学内容和评分的独立审查可与具体校正事件的研究结合起来:学习者对诊断提出质疑、更新概况或拒绝拟议的修改,组织做出回应。 在整个辅导和规划过程中,学习者的投入是否对以后的工作产生持久影响。 这种研究还可以审查该组织如何处理相互矛盾的证据,以及何时与人的教育者进行协商是有用的。

blocks.en: The human study used a researcher-assigned goal, while the revision benchmark examined prespecified low-performance conditions. The evaluated revisions primarily added support within an existing learning path. Everyday learning also involves changing direction, reducing workload, returning after interruptions, and deciding when further intervention is unnecessary. Future deployments could examine how learners and agents negotiate these choices as goals and available time change. Co-design with different learner groups, including learners with attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), could inform adjustable task lengths, pacing, reminders, and feedback. Optional game elements, such as short missions and progress milestones, offer another direction for organizing practice. Their value should be examined through sustained learning and perceived control, with room for learners to change or disable them as their needs evolve.
blocks.zh: 人类研究采用了研究人员指定的目标,而修订基准则审查了预先确定的低效条件。 经评价的修订主要在现有学习道路上增加了支持。 每天的学习还涉及改变方向、减少工作量、中断后返回以及决定何时没有必要进一步干预。 今后的部署可以审查学习者和代理人如何将这些选择作为目标和现有时间变化来谈判。 与不同的学习者群体共同设计,包括注意力缺失/过度活动障碍(ADHD)的学习者,可以告知可调整的任务长度、进度、提醒和反馈。 可选的游戏要素,如短任务和进度里程碑,为组织实践提供了又一方向. 应通过持续学习和自我控制来检查其价值,学习者可以随着需求的变化而改变或使其丧失能力。

blocks.en: Writing, the humanities, and workplace soft skills offer further settings in which to examine Capability Programs. The product-decision scenarios, written microprojects, and dialogue-based simulations in Study 3 provide initial examples of how AU can accommodate open-ended practice. They offer a starting point for dedicated studies of learning in these broader domains. Progress may become visible through successive drafts, stronger interpretations, or more effective responses to workplace situations. Assessment would need to capture these forms of development through domain-specific rubrics and expert or peer feedback. Differences in judgment could themselves become useful evidence for revision, particularly when several approaches are appropriate for the learner’s goal.
blocks.zh: 写作、人文和工作场所的软技能为审查能力方案提供了进一步的环境。 研究3中的产品决策设想、书面微型项目和以对话为基础的模拟提供了非盟如何适应开放式做法的初步实例。 它们为专门研究这些更广泛领域的学习提供了一个起点。 通过连续起草、更强有力的解释或更有效地应对工作场所情况,可以明显看到取得的进展。 评估需要通过特定领域和专家或同行反馈来掌握这些发展形式。 判断上的分歧本身可以成为修改的有用证据,特别是在几种方法适合学习者的目标时。

blocks.en: The longer-term vision of a “university for each learner” requires continuity across successive Capability Programs. Following learners across educational and career transitions would reveal when earlier evidence remains relevant and when reassessment is needed. Building on research in long-term agent memory [ 69 , 34 , 51 ] , AU could consolidate experience, revisit outdated assumptions, and preserve the source and context of capability claims. Learners would need practical ways to inspect, correct, delete, and carry these records between programs. As goals change, the organization may also need to redistribute responsibilities among agents and involve human educators, making teacher handoffs and continuity of support useful subjects for study. Sustained use brings questions of generation cost and waiting time, which remain to be measured across the complete workflow. On-demand generation and reuse of suitable materials could help manage these costs. Longitudinal deployments would allow retention and transfer to be evaluated alongside the learner effort and resources required to sustain support.
blocks.zh: “每个学习者都拥有一所大学”的较长期愿景要求连续的能力方案具有连续性。 在整个教育和职业过渡期间跟踪学习者将揭示以前的证据是否仍然相关,何时需要重新评估。 在长期代理记忆研究[69、34、51]的基础上,非盟可以巩固经验,重新审视过时的假设,并保留能力主张的来源和背景。 学习者需要切实可行的方法来检查、纠正、删除和在程序之间携带这些记录。 随着目标的变化,本组织还可能需要在代理人之间重新分配责任并让人类教育者参与,使教师的交流和支持的连续性成为有用的研究课题。 持续使用会产生生成成本和等待时间的问题,这些问题仍需要在整个工作流程中加以衡量。 根据需要生成和再利用适当的材料可有助于管理这些费用。 纵向部署将使保留和转移与学习者的努力和持续支持所需的资源一起得到评价。

blocks.en: 8  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We presented Agentic University as an instantiation of Human-Participatory Multi-Agent Organization. By connecting a correctable Human Node with a persistent Capability Program, AU allows learner contributions and assessed evidence to inform coordinated revisions to subsequent work. Three studies provide initial support for the integrated approach through evaluations of program quality, revision quality, and learner outcomes and experiences. The broader contribution is a design perspective in which human participation remains consequential across agent roles and the learning program remains revisable as the learner develops. Future work should examine whether this approach can sustain continuity, learner control, and reliable memory across open-ended, long-term learning trajectories.
blocks.zh: 我们提出 " 代理大学 " 作为人类参与的多代理组织的即兴演出。 通过将一个可纠正的人类节点与持续的能力方案联系起来,非盟允许学习者贡献和评估证据,为后续工作的协调修订提供参考。 三项研究通过评价方案质量、修订质量和学习者的成果和经验,为综合办法提供初步支持。 更广泛的贡献是设计观点,即人类的参与仍然影响着各种代理角色,随着学习者的发展,学习方案仍然可以重新审视。 今后的工作应审查这一方法能否维持连续性、学习者控制以及跨越开放式长期学习轨迹的可靠记忆。
